items.prompt: Sepia-toned 1970s flashback, faded vintage film grain, cinematic anime film still, semi-realistic painted anime art like a Makoto Shinkai movie. A 1970s Mumbai local train coach on fire at night, flames and thick smoke, silhouettes of people running on the platform in panic.
